title: Make a Greeter and a Max
prompt:
1. Write `greet(name)` that RETURNS a friendly sentence using the name (any sentence — build it with a template literal).
2. Write `maxOfTwo(a, b)` that RETURNS whichever number is larger (if equal, return either).
3. Log `greet("Ada")` and `maxOfTwo(7, 3)`.

tests.name: greet builds a sentence with the name inside
tests.hint: return `Hello, ${name}! welcome aboard.`; — any sentence works.

tests.name: maxOfTwo returns the larger
tests.hint: if (a >= b) { return a; } return b;  — or use the ternary a > b ? a : b

tests.name: examples logged
